sourceContext.originPage: ESG landing page - 'Our Material Drivers' section

contentPattern.structure: multi-row grid (3 per row) of distinct cards, each with image + eyebrow category label + description paragraph + CTA link

suitableFor: category/topic grids where each item has an image, an eyebrow label, a short description and its own CTA
material-topic or focus-area card grids (6+ items across multiple rows)
compact image + label + text + link card layouts
notSuitableFor: article listing cards with dates (use cards-article)
3-up spacious portrait feature cards without an eyebrow (use cards-feature)
